description: Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/selector-saturation-audit.ts. The current line reads exactly: `const degenerate = saturatedFraction >= satThreshold && variance <= varThreshold;` — this AND-condition only flags degeneracy when the selector is BOTH saturated AND low-variance, so it misses the case this audit exists to catch: undifferentiated arm posteriors (variance_of_means at or below varThreshold with distinct_means <= 1) that are NOT saturated, which make Thompson selection effectively uniform-random yet report 'healthy'. Change that single line to also treat undifferentiated means as degenerate, e.g.: `const degenerate = (saturatedFraction >= satThreshold && variance <= varThreshold) || (variance <= varThreshold && (snap.distinct_means ?? 2) <= 1);`. Preserve the cold-start guard above it unchanged. Change only this line.
